tagline: Send a yup, agree on a deal, then track what each of you has delivered.

linkPreview.title: You’ve got a yup
linkPreview.description: Someone sent you a yup to review. Nothing binds you until you sign.

service.unreachable: The service can’t be reached right now.
service.outdatedWeb: This page is out of date and can no longer make changes. Reload it to get the latest version.

INVITATION_CLAIMED.subject: The person you invited has joined ({code})
INVITATION_CLAIMED.body: The person you invited has opened your invitation and joined the yup. They can now review the terms you sent.

INVITATION_CLAIMED_UNCONFIRMED.subject: Confirm who joined your yup ({code})
INVITATION_CLAIMED_UNCONFIRMED.body: Someone has used your invitation link to join the yup. Check that it is the person you meant to invite, then confirm them. Nothing can be agreed until you do.

COUNTERPARTY_CONFIRMED.subject: You’ve been confirmed ({code})
COUNTERPARTY_CONFIRMED.body: The other party has confirmed that you are the person they invited. The two of you can now reach an agreement.

CLAIMANT_LEFT.subject: The person who opened your invitation has left ({code})
CLAIMANT_LEFT.body: The person who used your invitation link has left the yup before you confirmed them. Nothing they signed has any effect. Your proposal is still open: create a new invitation link for the person you meant to invite.

REVISION_SENT.subject: New terms to review ({code})
REVISION_SENT.body: The other party has sent new terms. Review them, then accept them, decline them or send your own.

AMENDMENT_PROPOSED.subject: A change to your agreement is proposed ({code})
AMENDMENT_PROPOSED.body: The other party has proposed a change to your agreement. The agreement stays as it is unless you accept the change.

ACCEPTANCE_WAITING.subject: The terms were accepted and are waiting for you ({code})
ACCEPTANCE_WAITING.body: The other party has accepted the terms. Their acceptance takes effect once you confirm that they are the person you meant to invite.

AGREEMENT_IN_FORCE.subject: Your agreement is signed and on record ({code})
AGREEMENT_IN_FORCE.body:
Both of you have signed the same terms, so the agreement is now in force and on record. Sign in to read, print or download your copy at any time: {recordLink}

From here you can track what each of you delivers.

AMENDMENT_IN_FORCE.subject: The change to your agreement is signed and on record ({code})
AMENDMENT_IN_FORCE.body: Both of you have signed the change, so it is now part of the agreement, and the agreement as it now stands is on record. Sign in to read, print or download your copy at any time: {recordLink}

AMENDMENT_DECLINED.subject: The change you proposed was declined ({code})
AMENDMENT_DECLINED.body: The other party has declined the change you proposed. The agreement stays as it was.

AMENDMENT_WITHDRAWN.subject: A proposed change was withdrawn ({code})
AMENDMENT_WITHDRAWN.body: The other party has withdrawn the change they proposed. The agreement stays as it was.

AMENDMENT_EXPIRED.subject: A proposed change expired ({code})
AMENDMENT_EXPIRED.body: A proposed change to your agreement expired before it was accepted. The agreement stays as it was.

DELIVERY_CLAIMED.subject: Something was marked as delivered ({code})
DELIVERY_CLAIMED.body: The other party has marked one of their contributions as delivered. Review it, then confirm it or dispute it.

CLAIM_RETRACTED.subject: A delivery was unmarked ({code})
CLAIM_RETRACTED.body: The other party has taken back their claim that a contribution was delivered. There is nothing for you to review for now.

DELIVERY_CONFIRMED.subject: A delivery was confirmed ({code})
DELIVERY_CONFIRMED.body: The other party has confirmed that they received one of your contributions.

DISPUTE_OPENED.subject: A delivery was disputed ({code})
DISPUTE_OPENED.body: The other party has disputed a contribution you marked as delivered. Read their reason in the agreement and respond.

CONTRIBUTION_WAIVED.subject: A contribution was waived ({code})
CONTRIBUTION_WAIVED.body: The other party has waived one of your contributions. You are no longer expected to deliver it.

END_PROPOSED.subject: A proposal to end your agreement ({code})
END_PROPOSED.body: The other party has proposed that the two of you end the agreement together. If you accept, everything still outstanding is released.

END_PROPOSAL_CANCELLED.subject: The proposal to end your agreement was cancelled ({code})
END_PROPOSAL_CANCELLED.body: The proposal to end the agreement together has been cancelled. The agreement carries on as before.

CLOSE_REQUESTED.subject: The other party has asked to close your agreement ({code})
CLOSE_REQUESTED.body: The other party has asked to close the agreement with matters still unresolved. You have a limited time to respond: you can add a statement, resolve what is outstanding or agree to end it. After that, the agreement closes as unresolved.

CLOSE_REQUEST_RETRACTED.subject: The request to close your agreement was withdrawn ({code})
CLOSE_REQUEST_RETRACTED.body: The other party has withdrawn their request to close the agreement. It stays open.

STATEMENT_ADDED.subject: A statement was added to your agreement ({code})
STATEMENT_ADDED.body: The other party has added a statement about the request to close the agreement. You can read it in the agreement.

INACTIVITY_PROMPTED.subject: Is your agreement still under way? ({code})
INACTIVITY_PROMPTED.body: Nothing has happened in this agreement for some time. If neither of you does anything in it, it will be closed as unresolved.

DUE_SOON.subject: Something you owe is due soon ({code})
DUE_SOON.body: At least one of your contributions is due soon and has not been marked as delivered. Open the agreement to see which and when. Once you have delivered it, mark it as delivered there.

OVERDUE_TO_DELIVER.subject: Something you owe is overdue ({code})
OVERDUE_TO_DELIVER.body: At least one of your contributions is past its due date and has not been marked as delivered. Open the agreement to see which. If you have delivered it, mark it as delivered there; if the date no longer works, you can propose a change to the agreement. The other party has been told as well.

OVERDUE_TO_RECEIVE.subject: Something owed to you is overdue ({code})
OVERDUE_TO_RECEIVE.body: At least one of the other party’s contributions is past its due date and has not been marked as delivered. Open the agreement to see which. If you have already received it, you can confirm it there. The other party has been reminded as well.

CLOSED_WITHDRAWN.subject: The offer was withdrawn ({code})
CLOSED_WITHDRAWN.body: The other party has withdrawn their offer, so the proposal is closed. Nothing was agreed.

CLOSED_DECLINED.subject: Your offer was declined ({code})
CLOSED_DECLINED.body: The other party has declined your offer, so the proposal is closed. Nothing was agreed.

CLOSED_EXPIRED.subject: The offer expired ({code})
CLOSED_EXPIRED.body: The offer expired before it was accepted, so the proposal is closed. Nothing was agreed.

CLOSED_COMPLETED.subject: Your agreement is complete ({code})
CLOSED_COMPLETED.body: Every required contribution has been accepted or waived. The agreement is complete and closed.

CLOSED_ENDED_BY_AGREEMENT.subject: You both agreed to end your agreement ({code})
CLOSED_ENDED_BY_AGREEMENT.body: The other party has agreed to end the agreement. It is closed, and everything still outstanding has been released.

CLOSED_UNRESOLVED.subject: Your agreement was closed unresolved ({code})
CLOSED_UNRESOLVED.body: The time to respond to the request to close has passed. The agreement is closed as unresolved, and each contribution keeps the status it had.

CLOSED_INACTIVE.subject: Your agreement was closed for inactivity ({code})
CLOSED_INACTIVE.body: Nothing happened in this agreement for a long time, so it has been closed as unresolved. Each contribution keeps the status it had.

REVISION_SENT_UNCONFIRMED.subject: The terms you were sent have changed ({code})
REVISION_SENT_UNCONFIRMED.body: The other party has changed the terms they sent you. Review them, then accept them if you agree. Until they confirm that you are the person they invited, you can’t decline them or send your own; you can leave the yup instead.

signIn.subject: {code} is your {productName} sign-in code
signIn.body:
Enter {code} to sign in to {productName}. The code works once and expires in a few minutes.

If you didn’t ask to sign in, ignore this email: nothing happens without the code, and nobody from {productName} will ever ask you for it.

deleteAccount.subject: {code} is your code to delete your {productName} account
deleteAccount.body:
Enter {code} to confirm that you want to delete your {productName} account. The code works once and expires in a few minutes. It can’t be used to sign in.

If you didn’t ask to delete your account, ignore this email and nothing will change. Nobody from {productName} will ever ask you for this code.

staffAlert.subject: A report is waiting for review

accountsCombined.subject: Two of your Yuppers accounts were combined

emailChanged.subject: Your {productName} email address was changed

emailRemoved.subject: Your {productName} email address was removed

sms.update: Yuppers.app: an agreement you turned on updates for has changed. See it: {link}. Reply STOP to opt out.
sms.optInConfirmation: Yuppers.app: You're signed up for text updates about this agreement, one text per status change. Msg frequency varies. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply HELP for help, STOP to opt out.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Enter your email address or phone number and we’ll send you a one-time code. There’s no password.
signIn.identifierHint: For a phone number outside the US, start with its country code.
signIn.checkInbox: Check your inbox, and your spam folder, for an email from {sender}.
signIn.checkInboxAnySender: Check your inbox, and your spam folder.
signIn.resendSoon: If it hasn’t arrived in 30 seconds, you can ask for another code.
signIn.codeHint: The 6-digit code we just sent you.
signIn.resent: A new code is on its way.
signIn.changeIdentifier: Use a different email address or phone number
signIn.introEmail: Enter your email address and we’ll send you a one-time code. There’s no password.
signIn.identifierHintCountries: For a phone number outside the US, start with its country code. We can only send codes to phone numbers starting {codes}.
signIn.identifierHintUs: US phone numbers only, such as (555) 123-4567.
signIn.emailOnly: Sign in with your email address. We can’t send codes to phone numbers at the moment.

inAppBrowser.noteIos: You’re in {app}’s browser, which may not keep you signed in. Open this page in Safari to stay signed in.
inAppBrowser.noteOther: You’re in {app}’s browser, which may not keep you signed in. Open this page in your browser to stay signed in.
inAppBrowser.menu: Or open the app’s menu and choose “Open in browser”, or copy the link and paste it into your browser.
inAppBrowser.copyFailed: The link couldn’t be copied. Use the app’s menu instead.

profile.firstIntro: We need this before you can sign anything.
profile.title: Account
profile.nameHint: Shown to the people you make yups with.
profile.adultConfirmed: You have confirmed that you are 18 or over.
profile.adultRequired: You have to be 18 or over to use our service.

identifiers.heading: Email and phone
identifiers.intro: You sign in with a code sent to either of these. Your account keeps at least one.
identifiers.changeNote: The new one replaces {identifier} once you enter the code we send to it.
identifiers.proveIntro: To change it, first enter a code we send to {identifier}, so we know it’s you.
identifiers.proveAddIntro: To add one, first enter a code we send to {identifier}, so we know it’s you.
identifiers.changeEmailTold: We’ll email {identifier} to say it was changed.
identifiers.onlyEmail: You can’t remove your email address: it’s the only way you sign in. Add a phone number first.
identifiers.onlyPhone: You can’t remove your phone number: it’s the only way you sign in. Add an email address first.
identifiers.removeIntro: You’ll sign in with {staying} from now on. To make sure it reaches you, we send a code there.
identifiers.removePhoneNote: Text updates for your agreements stop, and invitations already sent to this number stay as they are.
identifiers.removeEmailNote: We email this address to say it was removed. Invitations already sent to it stay as they are.
identifiers.noticePhoneChanged: The phone number on your Yuppers account was changed on {date}. If you didn’t do this, write to support@yuppers.app.
identifiers.noticePhoneRemoved: The phone number on your Yuppers account was removed on {date}. If you didn’t do this, write to support@yuppers.app.

combine.headingEmail: That email address is on another Yuppers account
combine.headingPhone: That phone number is on another Yuppers account
combine.intro: The code shows it’s yours, so you can combine that account into this one and have everything in one place.
combine.yupsDetail: {inForce} in force, {negotiating} waiting for a signature, {drafts} drafts, {closed} closed
combine.movesYups: Its yups move to this account. What was signed in them stays exactly as it was signed.
combine.emailAdded: Its email address, {identifier}, is added to this account.
combine.emailDropped: Its email address, {identifier}, is removed: you keep yours.
combine.phoneAdded: Its phone number, {identifier}, is added to this account.
combine.phoneDropped: Its phone number, {identifier}, is removed: you keep yours.
combine.paymentMove: Its payment options move here, because you have none. Anyone who owes you money is told they changed.
combine.paymentDropped: Its payment options are removed: you keep yours.
combine.textUpdatesMove: Its text updates keep going, to the same number.
combine.textUpdatesEnd: Its text updates stop, because its phone number is removed.
combine.devices: Its devices are signed out. Sign in on them again with this account.
combine.ends: The other account ends: nobody can sign in to it again. We tell every email address on both accounts that they were combined; if neither has one, this account shows it the next time you open the app.
combine.expires: You have 10 minutes to decide. After that, add the address again for a new code.
combine.done: Accounts combined. Everything is in this account now.
combine.noticeBanner: Two of your Yuppers accounts were combined into this one on {date}, by an email address or phone number you proved with a code. Everything from both is here now. If you didn’t do this, write to support@yuppers.app.

deletion.heading: Delete your account
deletion.intro: Deleting your account can’t be undone. Here is what it does.
deletion.loadFailed: We couldn’t check your agreements and proposals, so we can’t tell you yet what deleting would do to them.
deletion.deletedAccount: Your account. You’re signed out on every device, and your email address and phone number are removed from it.
deletion.deletedData: Your name and language, drafts you haven’t sent, and your list of people you’ve blocked.
deletion.signUpAgain: You can sign up again later with the same email address or phone number. That will be a new account, with none of your agreements or proposals.
deletion.exchangesHeading: What happens to your agreements and proposals
deletion.nothingOpen: You have no drafts, proposals or agreements that are still open.
deletion.drafts: {count, plural, one {# draft you haven’t sent is discarded.} other {# drafts you haven’t sent are discarded.}}
deletion.openProposals: {count, plural, one {# proposal that is waiting to be signed ends with nothing agreed. A proposal you sent is withdrawn; one sent to you is declined.} other {# proposals that are waiting to be signed end with nothing agreed. A proposal you sent is withdrawn; one sent to you is declined.}}
deletion.agreementsInForce: {count, plural, one {# agreement in progress gets a request to close, made in your name. The other party is told and has time to respond. After that it closes as unresolved, and each item keeps the status it has.} other {# agreements in progress each get a request to close, made in your name. The other party is told and has time to respond. After that each closes as unresolved, and each item keeps the status it has.}}
deletion.agreementsStand: Deleting your account doesn’t cancel or complete an agreement, and nothing is marked as delivered, received or waived for you. If something is still outstanding, consider settling it or agreeing with the other party to end the agreement first.
deletion.otherPartyTold: While an agreement or proposal is still open, the other party is shown that you’ve deleted your account.
deletion.keptAgreements: Agreements you signed stay in the other party’s record: the terms, your name as the agreement gives it, your signature and the history of the agreement. They keep their copy.
deletion.keptReports: Reports about an agreement or a proposal stay with the people who review them.
deletion.codeIntro: To confirm it’s you, we’ll send a one-time code to {identifier}.
deletion.codeChoice: To confirm it’s you, we’ll send a one-time code.
deletion.codeSent: We sent a code to {identifier}. It only works for deleting your account.
deletion.codeRequired: Enter the code we sent you.
deletion.confirmBody: This is the last step. Your account is deleted as soon as you confirm, and it can’t be brought back.
deletion.deleted: Your account has been deleted, and you’ve been signed out on every device.
deletion.otherPartyLeftActive: {name} has deleted their account and can no longer act in this agreement. The agreement and your record of it stay as they are.
deletion.otherPartyLeftNegotiating: {name} has deleted their account, so nothing can be agreed here any more. Whoever sent the proposal can withdraw it; otherwise it expires.

home.title: Your yups
home.empty: You have no yups yet. Start one, or open an invitation link someone sent you.
home.tooManyToday: You’ve started as many yups as one day allows. Try again tomorrow.

closedReasons.EXPIRED: The proposal expired before both of you had signed it.
closedReasons.CLOSE_REQUEST: One of you asked to close it and the time to respond ran out. Each item keeps the status it had.
closedReasons.INACTIVE: It was closed after a long time with no activity. Each item keeps the status it had.
closedReasons.DISCARDED: The draft was discarded before it was sent.

moneyStatus.CLAIMED: Marked paid, waiting for the receiver to confirm

terms.ownWords: The names, terms and descriptions here are the parties’ own words. We never translate or change them.
terms.dueOnAgreement: Due when the agreement is signed
terms.timezone: Dates are in the {timezone} time zone.
terms.moneyOutside: Paid outside our service, however the two of you arrange it. We move no money; we only record what each of you says about this payment.

composer.titleAmend: Propose a change to the agreement
composer.introFirst: Write down what each of you will do. Nothing is sent until you sign it.
composer.introCounter: These are the terms now on the table. Change what you need. Sending yours replaces them.
composer.introAmend: This is the agreement as it stands. Change what you need. It stays as it is until you have both signed the change.
composer.yourName: Your name, as it should appear
composer.termsHint: Anything you both need to agree that isn’t one of the items below.
composer.dateInZone: In {zone} time, the time zone this yup keeps its dates in.
composer.criteriaLabel: How you’ll both know it’s done (optional)
composer.requiredLabel: The agreement isn’t complete without this
composer.locked: This has been confirmed, so it can’t be changed or removed.
composer.noteHint: Sent with the terms, but not part of what you sign.
composer.saveFailed: Your draft couldn’t be saved. Your changes are still on this page; keep it open and try again.
composer.problemsSummary: {count, plural, one {# thing needs fixing before you can sign.} other {# things need fixing before you can sign.}}

problems.NO_REQUIRED_CONTRIBUTION: At least one item has to be required. Otherwise the agreement would be complete the moment it was signed.
problems.QUANTITY_INVALID: Enter the quantity as a number, such as {example}, or leave quantity and unit empty.
problems.AMOUNT_INVALID: Enter the amount as a number, such as {example}.
problems.DEPENDENCY_MISSING: Choose which item this waits for.
problems.DEPENDENCY_CYCLE: These items wait for each other, so neither would ever fall due. Choose a different one.

composer.signIntro: These are the terms exactly as they will be sent. Signing sends them to the other party.
composer.conflict: This yup changed while you were writing. Your unsent changes are kept. Check them against the latest terms before you sign.
composer.staleDraft: You have unsent changes that you started before the terms last changed.
composer.staleDraftDiscard: Start again from the current terms
composer.notAvailable: There is nothing to change on this yup right now.
composer.moneyOutside: Money is paid outside our service, however you two arrange it. We don’t move or hold it; we only record that one of you says it was paid and the other says it was received.
composer.discardText: Nothing has been sent, so nobody else has seen this. The draft closes and leaves your list. It can’t be reopened.
composer.effectsHeading: What this change does to each item
composer.effectsIntro: Once you have both signed the change:
composer.effectsSteer: To adjust for an item that is already confirmed, add a new item rather than changing one.

effects.CHANGED: Changed. It goes back to the start: anything marked delivered or paid no longer counts, though the history keeps it.
effects.NEW: New. It starts as not yet delivered or paid.
effects.LOCKED: Confirmed, so it can’t be changed or removed. Put it back as it was, or add a new item instead.
effects.REUSED: This item was removed earlier and can’t come back. Add it as a new item instead.

composer.removedCount: {count, plural, one {# item of the agreement is removed by this change.} other {# items of the agreement are removed by this change.}}

consent.heading: Signing electronically
consent.pendingReview: Placeholder wording, pending legal review. Not to be used for a real agreement.
consent.binding: By signing, you agree to these exact terms. Your signature is electronic and is meant to bind you in the same way a handwritten one would.
consent.electronic: You agree to sign electronically, and to receive this agreement and its records electronically.
consent.noJudge: We record what you both agreed and what each of you reports. We don’t hold money, decide disputes or guarantee that anyone delivers.
consent.agree: I have read these terms and I sign them.

invitationLink.intro: Yuppers doesn’t send this for you. Share the link with them, and they can read the proposal after signing in.
invitationLink.shownOnce: This link is shown only this once. If you lose it, use “Create a new link”: you get a new one, and the old one stops working.
invitationLink.copyFailed: It couldn’t be copied. Select the link and copy it yourself.
invitationLink.shareText: I’ve sent you a yup to review.
invitationLink.shareMessage: I’ve sent you a yup to review: {link}
invitationLink.qrLabel: QR code of the invitation link
invitationLink.qrHint: Someone with you can scan this with their phone’s camera to open the link.
invitationLink.qrFailed: The QR code couldn’t be shown. Copy the link instead.
invitationLink.unclaimed: No one has joined through your invitation link yet. The proposal may have been read; joining means signing in.
invitationLink.reissueIntro: Lost the link, or sent it to the wrong person? Create a new one. The old link stops working.
invitationLink.forIntro: Who is this yup for? Only the person you name here can open the link, and they can respond straight away, including proposing changes.
invitationLink.forHint: They have to sign in with exactly this to open it. With anything else the link won’t work for them, and you’ll need to create a new one.
invitationLink.forNoContact: We don’t email or text them. You send them the link yourself.
invitationLink.forMissing: Enter their email address or phone number, or choose a link for anyone instead.
invitationLink.forMissingEmail: Enter their email address, or choose a link for anyone instead.
invitationLink.forInvalid: This doesn’t look like an email address or a US phone number, such as (555) 123-4567.
invitationLink.forInvalidEmail: This doesn’t look like an email address.
invitationLink.forEmailOnly: Enter their email address. We can’t send sign-in codes to phone numbers at the moment, so they couldn’t use the link.
invitationLink.forCountry: We can only send sign-in codes to phone numbers starting {codes}, so they couldn’t use the link with this number.
invitationLink.forAnyone: Make a link for anyone instead
invitationLink.forAnyoneText: Anyone you give the link to can open it, and anyone else who gets hold of it can try to claim it. You’ll have to confirm who opened it before they can propose changes or decline. Until then, they can only read it, sign it as written, or leave.
invitationLink.boundSummary: Only someone who signs in with {identifier} will be able to use the link.
invitationLink.forAnyoneSummary: Anyone you give the link to can open it. You’ll have to confirm who opened it before they can propose changes or decline.
invitationLink.sendRule: Yuppers doesn’t send it for you. {name} gets nothing until you share this link.
invitationLink.sharedNotice: Once it’s sent, {name} can read the yup after signing in. You’ll see on the yup’s page when they join.
invitationLink.laterHint: You can send it from the yup’s page. It reminds you until {name} joins.
invitationLink.notSentYet: You haven’t sent them the link. Yuppers doesn’t send it for you: {name} gets nothing until you do.
invitationLink.sharedLongAgo: You shared the link on {date}, and nobody has joined through it. If {name} hasn’t seen it, send it again, or create a new link.
invitationLink.sendAgain: To send it now, create a new link. The old one stops working.

invitation.title: You’ve got a yup to review
invitation.signInToRead: Sign in to read it. Nothing binds you until you sign.
invitation.introSignedIn: {name} wants to agree this with you. Read it, then respond to accept it, decline it or propose changes.
invitation.notBinding: Nothing binds you until you sign. Once you have both signed, this yup is a binding agreement.
invitation.boundSignedIn: This invitation is for one particular person. Only someone signed in with the email address or phone number it was sent to can respond.
invitation.missing: The invitation link has lost its last part. Open it again from the message it came in, or ask the sender for a new one.
invitation.ownInvitation: This is your own invitation link. Send it to the other party; you can’t use it yourself.
invitation.sentToEmail: This invitation was sent to an email address that isn’t on your account. Type that address to add it and open the invitation.
invitation.sentToPhone: This invitation was sent to a phone number that isn’t on your account. Type that number to add it and open the invitation.
invitation.sentToReplacesEmail: Your account already has a different email address. Adding this one replaces it, and you’ll sign in with it from now on. First, enter a code we send to one already on your account.
invitation.sentToReplacesPhone: Your account already has a different phone number. Adding this one replaces it, and you’ll sign in with it from now on. First, enter a code we send to one already on your account.
invitation.signInInstead: Or sign out, and sign in with that address instead.

claimant.rejectRemoves: {name} is removed from this yup and can no longer see it.
claimant.rejectVoids: Anything they signed here is void and can never take effect.
claimant.rejectKeeps: Your proposal stays open. The link you sent can’t be used again, so you’ll create a new one for the person you meant to invite.
claimant.rejectQuiet: They aren’t sent a message about it. For them, the yup is simply no longer there.
claimant.rejected: They’ve been removed, and nothing they signed has any effect. Create a new link for the person you meant to invite.
claimant.linkUsed: The link you sent has been used and can’t be used again. Nobody is in this yup with you now.
claimant.limits: Until they confirm you, you can’t decline these terms or propose changes. You can leave this yup instead.
claimant.leaveText: You’ll no longer see this yup, and the link you opened won’t work again. {name} is told that you left, and can invite someone else.
claimant.leaveVoids: Anything you signed here is void and can never take effect.
claimant.invitationIntroSignedIn: {name} wants to agree this with you. Read it, then respond. You can sign it straight away. Before you can decline it or propose changes, {name} has to confirm that you are the person they invited.
claimant.blockLeaves: You leave this yup and can no longer see it. Anything you signed in it is void.
claimant.blockedAfterLeaving: You are no longer in this yup.
claimant.voidSignature: Signed on {date} by someone who had opened the invitation and was removed, or left, on {since}, before being confirmed. This signature is void: it never took effect and never can.

safety.heading: Report or block
safety.reportIntro: Tell us what is wrong. We review every report. {name} isn’t told that you reported it.
safety.reportProposalIntro: Tell us what is wrong with this proposal. We review every report. The person who sent it isn’t told that you reported it.

reasons.PROHIBITED_TRADE: Something illegal, or not allowed here
reasons.SCAM: A scam, or an attempt to cheat someone
reasons.IMPERSONATION: Someone pretending to be someone else
reasons.UNWANTED: Spam, or something I never asked for

safety.detailsHint: Only the people who review reports see this.
safety.reportSent: We’ve received your report and will review it.
safety.tooManyReports: That’s as many reports as can be sent in one day. Try again tomorrow.
safety.blockStops: {name} won’t be able to join a yup you start, and you won’t be able to join one they start.
safety.blockEnds: Any proposal still waiting to be signed between the two of you is withdrawn or declined.
safety.blockKeeps: An agreement you’ve both signed stays in force. Either of you can still complete it or close it.

export.about: This is a copy of the record of one agreement or proposal, as the service held it when the copy was made. What the parties wrote appears exactly as they wrote it.
export.signatures: Each signature was made by a person signed in to an account. The only check of who that person is was a single one-time code, sent to an email address or a phone number, which they entered when they signed in. That can be some time before they signed. No other proof of identity was asked for.
export.statements: Marking something as delivered, confirming it, disputing it or waiving it, and every note, reason and statement, are what the parties themselves recorded. The service kept them as they were made and did not check whether any of them is true.
export.contentHash: The fingerprint of a version is the SHA-256 digest, written in hexadecimal, of its signed terms as canonical JSON (RFC 8785) in UTF-8. In a downloaded copy the signed terms are the “signed” part of each revision and the fingerprint is its “content_hash”, so anyone can compute it again and compare. The message sent with a version, and the date it stays open until, are not part of what is signed.

verification.EMAIL_OTP: A single one-time code sent to an email address. Nothing else about the signer was checked.
verification.PHONE_OTP: A single one-time code sent by text message to a phone number. Nothing else about the signer was checked.
